name: @redpoint-ai/mcp-drh
author: Redpoint
description: Data Readiness Hub (OP-Services) MCP server — the Data Readiness Hub tool surface (Keycloak-signon auth, incoming-auth middleware, server-side X-ClientId + databaseId scoping). Sibling to mcp-rpi.

scripts.//disabled:build:macos: DISABLED — not in the release set (build:all = linux + windows only). Rename key back to build:macos to re-enable. bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/http.ts --outfile dist/rp-drh-mcp-macos-arm64/rp-drh-mcp-macos-arm64
scripts.//disabled:build:macos-intel: DISABLED — not in the release set. Rename key back to build:macos-intel to re-enable. bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/http.ts --outfile dist/rp-drh-mcp-macos-intel/rp-drh-mcp-macos-intel
scripts.build:all: bun run build:linux && bun run build:windows && bun run build:copy-templates
